channel.title: AI Engineering — Nicholas Garcia
channel.description: Build logs from a small fleet of AI agents run every day.

item.title: The Mechanical Check Test
item.description: One question decides whether an agent may act alone: can a cheap mechanical check prove the result? The post shows the test inside a running daemon.

item.title: Review What Actually Runs
item.description: A nightly code-review agent picks its files with a formula you can print: how often the machine runs a file, times how long since anyone read it.

item.title: A Security Check With No Model in It
item.description: Six checks, once a month, read-only, with no model calls and no secret ever printed: the most reliable job in my fleet has no model in it.

item.title: Ship the Read-Only Report First
item.description: To automate your contacts and obligations, start with a job that cannot write anything, then add write access one tested phase at a time.
